message.content: {"skill": {"name": "Body Position and Foot Contact Check", "description": "Verify head, shoulders, and buttocks contact with the bench and flat, stable feet (including declared foot blocks) to determine whether a position or foot-contact red applies. Use when position faults or foot-slide claims are raised.", "prompt": "Apply the bench position criteria to the attempt under review. Check head, shoulders, and buttocks contact with the bench surface; check feet are flat on the platform and do not change position during the attempt; account for any declared foot blocks. Use available camera evidence (e.g., side view) to assess buttocks lift and foot slide. Distinguish negligible, continuous-contact micro-movement from an actual position fault. Return a determination of whether a position/foot-contact red applies, with the specific criterion cited.", "triggers": ["Coach argues foot slide was negligible and foot always flat", "Side camera shows possible micro-slide or buttocks lift", "Position fault is raised as a basis for a red"], "tags": ["powerlifting", "bench_press", "position_check", "foot_contact", "technical_judging"], "asset_type": "micro_skill", "asset_node_id": "micro_skill_node", "granularity": "micro", "objective": "Detect buttocks lift, loss of bench contact, or foot position faults.", "domain": "Powerlifting Refereeing", "task_family": "technical_judging", "method_family": "visual_fault_detection", "stage": "position_check", "applicable_signals": ["Claim that foot slide was negligible and foot remained flat", "Side camera evidence of micro-slide or possible buttocks lift", "Declared or undeclared foot blocks in question"], "intervention_moves": ["Confirm head, shoulders, and buttocks remain in contact with the bench surface", "Confirm feet are flat on the platform and do not change position during the attempt", "Check whether foot blocks were declared and whether feet stayed flat on them", "Assess camera evidence for buttocks lift and foot slide, distinguishing continuous-contact micro-movement from a fault", "State whether a position/foot-contact red applies and cite the specific criterion"], "contraindications": ["Fault under review is bar path or lockout", "Fault under review is a command fault"], "workflow_steps": ["Identify the position criteria in scope: bench contact (head, shoulders, buttocks) and foot contact (flat, stable, no position change).", "Check declared foot blocks;
